name: tokenbrief
description: Resolves a crypto token from a ticker, contract address or CoinGecko/CMC/DexScreener link and returns live metrics, pairs and rule-based risk flags from CoinGecko and DexScreener (keyless).
author: meitipro1

tools.name: resolve_token
tools.description: Resolve what the user typed to one token. Returns status resolved | ambiguous | not_found. When ambiguous, show the candidates and call again with https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/<cgId> of the one the user picks.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Exactly what the user typed: a ticker ($PEPE), an EVM or Solana contract address, or a CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap or DexScreener URL.

tools.name: fetch_metrics
tools.description: Live price, 24h change, market cap, FDV, volume, liquidity, supply, ATH, listing age, socials and same-ticker coins. Each number carries its source and fetch time.

tools.name: fetch_pairs
tools.description: Top DexScreener pairs by liquidity: liquidity, 24h volume, buys, sells, age.

tools.name: risk_flags
tools.description: Rule-based risk flags computed from fetch_metrics and fetch_pairs results. Report them as returned; never add flags of your own.

parameters.name: pairs
parameters.description: the full fetch_pairs result; omit when there is no address
